column1: # ALL.corrected.tsv -- programs the ORACLE CANNOT GRADE (a defect in the oracle's output, or a feature the oracle lacks), graded against the ISO-correct ref instead -- Lon 2026-10-05: a bug in the oracle, or a feature it does not have, means the oracle does not grade that test. FORMAT: name<TAB>reason

column2: fpc issue #41609: fpc -Miso put(textfile) does not advance the file buffer, so its ref is the bytes 62 00 00 00 0A where ISO 7185 6.9.2 (put) gives Ohab then a newline; the program then exits 2 (TEXTFILE.txt was never written) in both, as ALL.wantrc says. Lon 2026-10-05: do not copy the bug
